g.text: Core tier, 180 s budget, k ≤ 3 puzzles per cell (sampled): treat single cells as indicative. Winner = most puzzles solved, then lowest median time. Cell text: the winner's speed margin over the runner-up (runner-up median ÷ winner median), or 'x/3' when the winner solved more

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: puzzles than any other solver ('only' = the other solvers' uniqueness runs were pruned); N/M/D = naive/MRV/DLX tied. n = 1 has only 2 distinct puzzles and is drawn at the nearest sparsity column. Medians mostly from serial (single-process) timings.
